name: Raindrop.io
summary: All-in-one bookmark manager for saving, organizing and searching links, media and files, with apps on every platform.
description: A bookmark manager that saves links, articles, videos, images and files into collections with tags, filters and multiple view modes (grid, headlines, masonry, list). Full-text search covers saved pages, PDFs and YouTube transcripts; the Pro plan adds permanent copies, cloud backup, upload space and cleanup tools. Available as browser extensions (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge), desktop and mobile apps, plus an API and an MCP integration for AI apps.
contains: unlimited bookmarks, collections and devices on the free plan
full-text search across pages, PDFs and YouTube transcripts (Pro)
apps for Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Windows, Mac, iPad, iPhone and Android
view modes: grid, headlines, masonry, list
highlights, instant preview, reminders, batch processing, import/export, light and dark themes
integrations API; MCP for Claude, ChatGPT and other AI apps
automatic web archive copies and Dropbox/Google Drive backup
